examples.en: The two teams were neck and neck until the last minute.

dropped.reason: unattested; sít sao is about tightness (sense 1)

senses.gloss_en: to sing together in a chorus

senses.gloss_en: to produce; to generate (only in compounds, as in sản xuất)

senses.gloss_en: late afternoon, when the sun is going down

senses.gloss_en: taking the opportunity; while one is at it

examples.en: This book introduces the structure of the human body.

examples.vi: Ông ngoại cười khoái chí khi thấy cháu về.

senses.gloss_en: to be kept apart by distance or obstacles; to separate

senses.gloss_en: to admit defeat; to throw in the towel (often said jokingly)

examples.vi: Thôi, tôi chào thua, câu này khó quá!

senses.gloss_en: to file (wood, metal or nails) smooth

examples.vi: Tóc anh ấy bị cháy sém một đoạn.

senses.gloss_en: to display; to show off; to lay bare

examples.vi: Sau cơn mưa, cây cối trong vườn trông tươi tốt hẳn.
